# CGEL claim catalogue

> Claims from The Cambridge Grammar of the English Language (Huddleston and Pullum 2002), tested against the book itself and against usage, by Brett Reynolds. 177 claims; snapshot 2026-11-20 (92eaeb3).

## How to use this data

- Each record gives CGEL's claim (a paraphrase, with its chapter, section and page in the corrected printing used for the audit), a verdict (`assessment`), the finding and its limits, a proposed rewording where needed, and the evidence item by item.
- Verdicts: Correction: Correction proposes changing a particular claim.; Qualification: Qualification narrows its scope or evidential force.; Argument gap: Argument gap identifies an inference the evidence fails to establish.; Textual mismatch: Textual mismatch records incompatible wording or labels across passages.; Extension: Extension supplies an account or test beyond the description.; Production error: Production error records a misprint, a wrong cross-reference or a misnumbered example that the authors’ errata do not list.; Supported: Supported means that the tested distinction survives the stated challenge.; Open: Open means that live alternatives remain.; Author erratum: Author erratum identifies a correction by the authors.
- Verdicts include positive controls and known errata; their proportions don't estimate CGEL's error rate.
- Text fields may contain <i>...</i> around mentioned forms; the Markdown files render them as *...*.
- Evidence with `url: null` cites a working note, an unpublished draft or a local copy that isn't online.
- `reviewed: false` marks an entry drafted with AI assistance that the author hasn't yet checked; treat its verdict as provisional. Large language models served as research and drafting aids throughout.

## Data

- [All claims](https://brettreynolds.ca/cgel-claims/claims.json): one JSON document with labels, guide and claims.
- [One claim per line](https://brettreynolds.ca/cgel-claims/claims.jsonl).
- Per claim: `https://brettreynolds.ca/cgel-claims/api/<ID>.json` and `.md`, for example [CG-0107](https://brettreynolds.ca/cgel-claims/api/CG-0107.json).
- [Workbook](https://brettreynolds.ca/cgel-claims/cgel-claim-catalogue.xlsx): the same data as an Excel file.

## Pages

- [Claims in CGEL page order](https://brettreynolds.ca/cgel-claims/), [by argument family](https://brettreynolds.ca/cgel-claims/families/), [guide](https://brettreynolds.ca/cgel-claims/guide/).
